post.description:
Find shows by city, keyword or date, then pass a show id to show or showtimes.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 provider_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

date.description: Only shows with a performance on this local date, YYYY-MM-DD. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

limit.description:
Shows per page.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 50; default 20.

location_id.description:
TodayTix city id from locations (1 New York, 2 London, 3 Chicago, 4 SF Bay Area, 5 Los Angeles, 6 Washington DC, 7 Boston, 17 Sydney, 18 Melbourne, 19 Brisbane, 93 Perth, 95 Adelaide).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100000.

max_price.description:
Only shows whose lowest regular price is at most this amount in the city's currency.

Provider reference: minimum 0.

offset.description:
0-based offset; use next_offset from the previous page.

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 100000; default 0.

query.description: Keyword matched against show names (e.g. `hamilton`). Omit to browse the whole city.

sort_by.description:
`price` (lowest regular price) or `recent_views` (recently viewed); omitted, the site orders by popularity.

Provider reference: allowed values ["price", "recent_views"].

sort_order.description:
Direction for sort_by; the site's default when omitted.

Provider reference: allowed values ["asc", "desc"].

timezone.description: IANA timezone the `date` is in. Defaults to the city's timezone for the known location ids; required with `date` for any other id.

200.description:
Discover shows in a TodayTix city (api.todaytix.com /api/v2/shows, fieldset SHOW_SUMMARY): optional keyword, performance date, price cap and sort. Each card carries the stable show id, venue, run dates, event-level low prices (regular, rush, lottery; fee inclusion unknown), availability flags, promotion and review summary. Offset pagination with the site's total.

The response contains the tool result directly.

date_to.description: Keep performances on or before this local date, YYYY-MM-DD. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

200.description:
Performance list for one show (api.todaytix.com /api/v2/shows/{id}/showtimes?includeNoInventory=true): every scheduled performance with local date/time and UTC offset, per-performance regular ticket snapshot (lowest price, face value, seat counts, price bands, sale cut-off), disclosed Lottery and Rush windows, and cast notices. Prices are per ticket as displayed; fee inclusion is not stated by the site. Optional date window and offset pagination over the site's full list. Seat-level sections are not available (AWS WAF bot control).

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `showtimes` as the primary payload key.

value.description:
The Stephen Sondheim Theatre is a treasured gem within the heart of New York City. Located in the bustling Times Square district, it stands proudly, retaining its historical charm midst contemporary edifices. The theatre, formerly known as Henry Miller's Theatre, is deeply rooted in theatrical history, having hosted numerous Broadway classics since its inception in 1918. It boasts art nouveau architecture bathed in gentle, welcoming lights, with intricate details that add to its grandeur. A walk inside reveals a relaxing ambiance with ornamented ceilings, beautiful chandeliers, red velvet seats, and a sizeable stage that brings performances to life. Dedicated to the legendary composer Stephen Sondheim, the theatre's rich legacy continues by staging some of the most critically acclaimed plays, musicals, and performances, all enjoyed from the comfort of its 1,055 seats. 

**How to Get There** 
Stephen Sondheim Theatre is conveniently located at 124 West 43rd Street, accessible via various modes of transportation. Visitors can reach the theatre by subway, taking the B, D, F, or M train to 42nd Street/Bryant Park or the 1, 2, 3, 7, N, Q, R, S, or W train to Times Square/42nd Street. Buses M5, M7, M20, M42, or M104 also offer routes to Times Square. For those who prefer driving, several paid parking garages are available nearby.
value.name: Stephen Sondheim Theatre
value.short_description: The Stephen Sondheim Theatre is a cherished historical venue in Times Square, known for its Broadway classics and art nouveau architecture.
